title: Dance Till Dawn

outfit_card.silhouette: Carnival-inspired flared silhouette featuring a fan-sculpted strapless bodice, cinched harlequin waistline, and a tiered, voluminous bell-shaped micro-crinoline skirt with asymmetric layered ruffles.

outfit_card.upper_garment_and_sleeves: Strapless corset with metallic pleated fan pleats, harlequin checkered bow sash, jeweled choker with dangling ribbons, and detached sheer knit arm sleeves ending in flared, ruffled cuffs.
outfit_card.lower_garment_and_legwear: Voluminous tiered mini skirt composed of star-embroidered organza, ribbon-bordered hems, harlequin ruffles, worn over patterned festive stockings and decorative, heeled carnival booties.
outfit_card.signature_props_and_motifs: Shoulder-mounted plush teddy bear with balloon accents, carousel unicorn mount, cascading party streamers, and glowing carnival star motifs.
